papers.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
papers.problem: Coding agents that run for long tasks get feedback that often misses the real problem or gets ignored.
papers.fix: Opera tracks each correction until the problem is fixed, and raises task success by up to 15.0 percentage points.
papers.practicalUseCase: A critic that follows up on its advice makes coding agents more reliable, so add follow-up checks.
papers.limitation: The gains come from three coding benchmarks and four models, so real projects may differ.

papers.title: Skill Constellations: Tracing the Supply Chain of Agent Skills on GitHub
papers.problem: Developers copy agent skills between repositories with no registry, versions, or source record, so nobody knows who copied from whom.
papers.fix: Among 2,193,119 skill adoptions, a few repositories source most copies; auditing the top 100 stops 14.9% of risky adoptions.
papers.practicalUseCase: A fix at the source rarely reaches copies, so audit the few source repositories and pin skills by version.
papers.limitation: The ranking model predicts which repositories others copy from, so it may miss new sources.

papers.title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
papers.problem: Teams cannot predict how well a fast decoding schedule will work before they run it.
papers.fix: The data's shape sets the fewest lossless steps; fewer steps always cost quality, and the authors rank that cost beforehand.
papers.practicalUseCase: You can choose a decoding schedule for text, image, or video models without trial runs.
papers.limitation: The authors confirm most, not all, of their predicted rankings across text, image, and video tests.

papers.title: Trends and Determinants of Sustainability Sukuk Issuance: Evidence from Global Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Few people know how sustainability sukuk issuance grew or what sets the size of each issue.
papers.fix: Of 11,944 issuances, most cluster in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Saudi Arabia; equity-based contracts give larger issues than sale-based ones.
papers.practicalUseCase: Issuers who want bigger sustainability sukuk should favor equity-based contracts, strong security, and USD or Euro denomination.
papers.limitation: The data covers 2012 to 2022 and shows links between features and issue size, not cause.

papers.title: Sustainability Committees and Environmental Initiatives: Insights from Dual Banking Systems in Emerging Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks set up sustainability committees, but it is unclear whether these committees lead to real environmental action.
papers.fix: Committees link to better environmental scores, but in Islamic banks only for overall and resource-reduction scores, not products.
papers.practicalUseCase: A committee alone may only change reports at Islamic banks, so regulators should check for real green products.
papers.limitation: The panel regressions show association, not cause, and cover only emerging markets with both bank types.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Strategies to Enhance Islamic Banks’ Competitiveness and Sustainable Development
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Islamic banks in Jordan lack clear evidence on whether AI and big data help them compete and stay sustainable.
papers.fix: AI use, big data skills, and data management all raise competitiveness and sustainability, while staff digital skill raises competitiveness only.
papers.practicalUseCase: Banks should invest in AI and data systems, since staff training alone does not improve sustainability.
papers.limitation: The survey covers 214 managers at 15 Jordanian Islamic banks at one time, so it cannot prove cause.

papers.title: ICT, High-Tech Exports, and Institutions as Drivers of Bank Expansion Growth in a Dual Banking System
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks lack clear evidence on which digital and institutional factors drive growth in dual banking systems.
papers.fix: In 218 banks across 12 countries, ICT adoption drives growth most; high-tech exports help only alongside ICT.
papers.practicalUseCase: Digital infrastructure pays off most, so policymakers should build it before expecting growth from exports alone.
papers.limitation: The study covers 12 countries from 2010 to 2023 and shows statistical links between factors and growth.

papers.title: Determinants of Financial Inclusion in the OIC and OECD Countries: Are They Different?
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.institution: International Centre for Education in Islamic Finance
papers.problem: Many Muslim-majority countries still exclude large groups from financial services, even as Islamic finance expands.
papers.fix: Across 35 countries, income, education, institution quality, and internet access drive financial inclusion in OIC countries.
papers.practicalUseCase: OIC countries should invest in digital infrastructure, youth and women empowerment, and income growth to widen financial access.
papers.limitation: The model covers 35 countries from 2005 to 2021 and shows links, not cause.

papers.title: Global prevalence of impostor phenomenon in medical students: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.institution: National University Toribio Rodríguez de Mendoza
papers.problem: Medical students face constant exams and peer comparison, which may make them feel like frauds despite their success.
papers.fix: Impostor feelings are frequent among medical students before they are licensed, though the estimates vary widely between studies.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you feel like a fraud in a high-pressure field, you are not alone, so talk about it early.
papers.limitation: Results differ a lot across studies and depend on sampling method and region, so the pooled rate is uncertain.
